facts.text: The repository is an overlay: its installation copies the openarm URDF, the agent package and the four tabletop task files into a ManiSkill checkout rather than installing a package
The required ManiSkill version is v3.0.0b21
The clone lists PushCube-v1, PullCube-v1 and PickCube-v1 as its runnable tasks
PickCubeEnv defaults the robot to the openarm agent
The openarm PickCube config uses cube_half_size 0.02, goal_thresh 0.025, cube_spawn_half_size 0.05, cube_spawn_center (0, 0) and max_goal_height 0.3
The cube xy position is drawn uniformly from the spawn half-size around the spawn centre and its z is the cube half-size
The goal xy position uses the same draw and its z is a uniform draw up to max_goal_height above the cube z
The observation extras are is_grasped, tcp_pose and goal_pos, plus obj_pose, tcp_to_obj_pos and obj_to_goal_pos when the state observation is used
Success is the goal-site to cube distance at or below goal_thresh and a static robot
The dense reward adds a reaching term 1 - tanh(5 * distance), the grasp flag, a placement term and a static term, and sets 5 where success is true
OpenArm is registered with uid openarm and the URDF at robots/openarm/openarm.urdf
The openarm reset keyframe is a nine-element joint position array
The arm has seven openarm_joint joints and the gripper one openarm_finger_joint1
The arm's pd_ee_delta_pos controller bounds the end-effector position delta to -0.1 and 0.1
The gripper joint position controllers bound the opening to 0 and 0.0451
OpenArm.is_grasping checks pairwise contact forces with a minimum force of 0.5 N and a maximum contact angle of 85 degrees
OpenArm.is_static compares the largest absolute joint velocity with a threshold of 0.2

determinism.notes: cap.world.reset.v1 passes the seed to the environment reset and this package's fake uses Python's random.Random; the upstream draws its placements from ManiSkill's torch generator, so one seed does not produce the same positions on the two

gaps: the fake is an analytic stand-in: the TCP and the cube move by placeholder kinematics, and there is no rigid-body dynamics, contact, friction, mass, actuator, joint controller or URDF model
the grasp test is a distance test, not the pairwise contact-force test of OpenArm.is_grasping (openarm.py:255-286), and the robot is always static because the fake has no joint velocities
the clone does not state the environment control timestep, so timestep_ms is 0: one tick is one environment step and no physical or wall-clock time is modelled

the observation only carries the members of _get_obs_extra (pick_cube.py:148-161); ManiSkill's full state observation (robot qpos/qvel), the 128 x 128 camera observations and rendering are NOT COVERED
the openarm URDF, the seven-joint arm and its controller are not modelled; the action limits are the controller config bounds of openarm.py:100-109 and :183-190, not a validated workspace
only PickCube-v1 is covered; PullCube-v1 and PushCube-v1 are not
the upstream SAPIEN environment was never opened or compared with the fake, and no physical device is modelled or validated
